set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

pico_sdk_init()

add_executable(IMUAdapterFirmware
  IMUAdapterFirmware.c
)

pico_generate_pio_header(IMUAdapterFirmware ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/uart_rx.pio)

pico_enable_stdio_usb(IMUAdapterFirmware 0)

                      hardware_pio
